items.title: 5 Children, Including Three 1-Year-Old Boys, Among 19 Killed in Russian Strike on Pryluky
items.description: Five children, including three 1-year-old boys, are among 19 people killed in a Russian missile strike on a residential building in Pryluky, northern Ukraine. The attack was part of a massive overnight barrage that killed at least 25 people nationwide and injured dozens more.

items.title: Israel, three years after October 7: A nation's traumas and blind spots
items.description: Amid an election campaign, Israel is commemorating the victims of the Hamas terrorist attack. Since the tragedy, the country has pursued an endless war, driven by a desire for revenge, without questioning the failures that led to the disaster.
